text:
Alice: Quick sync — ACME private pilot looming, they asked for HSM-backed KMS + prewarm/burst SLAs. Need to align product/eng/runtime/infra/security on launch gates, oncall, and capacity. Can folks call out blockers and must-have acceptance criteria?

Ben: TL;DR: runtime can hit ~50 QPS steady with prefix/KV prefetch, but requires reserved pod pool + model quantization. Perf test runway ~3 weeks.

Claire: Infra: We can reserve dedicated GPUs for the pilot but need exact VM/GPU count, network egress path for on-prem peering, and KV store size (estimate 250GB). Please confirm hours/weeks for capacity reservation.

Devon: Security flag: HSM/KMS integration is a blocker until integration tests + attestation run. We also need key rotation policy and a brief pen-test window. Add a gating checkbox for KMS_OK.

Eva: From SRE: Oncall coverage required for pilot weeks 0–4 (3 people week of launch). Target SLO for pilot: p95 < 200ms, error-rate < 0.5%. Canary plan needed (10% -> 50% -> 100%) and automated rollback on error-rate spike.

Frank: Customer asks for 10% roll in week1, move to 50% week2 if no regressions. Acceptance criteria they gave: no functional regressions vs hosted, latency delta < 25% p95, and no more than 2% increased cost per request.

Ben: Proposal for canary + monitors: 
```
canary_plan:
  week1: 10%
  week2: 50%
  rollback: instant route to hosted-model
  monitors: [token_throughput, error_rate, latency_p95]
  alert_triggers:
    - error_rate > 0.5% sustained 5m
    - latency_p95 > 200ms sustained 10m
```

Claire: Infra asks: floor for pilot = 4 x A100 (or 8 x A10s), 2TB NVMe cache, dedicated subnet. If runtime quantizes to 4-bit we can drop GPU count by ~2. Need final decision by EOD Fri to book. Cost delta ~+$12k/mo.

Ben: Tradeoff note: 4-bit quant reduces RAM footprint but adds slight latency increase (~5–10ms p95). We'll run perf tests on Monday with quantized weights and prefix caching.

Devon: Security process: we need a smoke integration test that hits KMS endpoints and verifies attestation tokens. Also require an approval PR from SecOps with checklist items: [KMS_OK, ROTATION_POLICY_DOC, PEN_TEST_SCHEDULE]. No pilot traffic until checklist is green.

Eva: Runbook stub for pilot incidents: 
```
runbook_pilot_acme:
  scoreboard: monitor p50/p95/p99, error rate, throttles
  initial_actions:
    - escalate to eng-runtime on alert
    - revert canary to hosted (route switch)
    - if HSM errors: failover to cached keys + page SecOps
  oncall: [eva, eng-runtime primary, infra primary]
```

Frank: Can we get final owners and dates? Customer expects canary start in 2 weeks.

Ben: Owners: runtime -> Ben, infra -> Claire, security -> Devon, sre -> Eva, product -> Alice. Timeline: perf tests Mon-Tue, infra reservation by Fri, security integration test Wed, canary start in 14 days if all green.

Claire: I'll book the infra hold for 7 days pending approval (will confirm SKU in thread).

Devon: I'll schedule a 1-hour KMS attestation window Wed + kick off pen-test scheduling.

Alice: Good. Final acceptance checklist to close before canary: 
- perf test results (p95 vs hosted within 25%)
- KMS_OK attestation
- infra reserved and network validated
- runbook + oncall slots confirmed
- cost estimate signoff from finance

Ben: +1. I'll post perf logs here when ready.

Frank: I'll sync with customer about the 2-week window and set expectation for 10% initial canary.

deploy-bot: Automated note: "Deployment window requested: 2026-04-15 02:00-06:00 UTC. Please confirm approvals."

Alice: Confirmed owners and steps. If anyone has an absolute blocker please flag before EOD so we can move infra hold. :eyes: :thumbsup:

Claire: Holding for now — will update with SKU and cost by EOD. :white_check_mark:

Devon: Blocking item: need final key rotation policy doc; I'll review a PR today.

Eva: Oncall rota drafted, pinged people.

Ben: Perf tests queued, will share results in this thread.

Alice: Thanks all — let's reconvene in this thread for updates.
